SEARCH
Package org.geysermc.paletter.creative

Interface ItemMatcher

All Known Implementing Classes:
ItemMatcher.And, ItemMatcher.BlockState, ItemMatcher.Custom, ItemMatcher.Damage, ItemMatcher.Exact, ItemMatcher.Id, ItemMatcher.Namespace, ItemMatcher.Not
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ItemMatcher
Selects creative stacks, e.g. as an anchor to insert after, or to remove. Matchers print readably, so a placement that found nothing can be reported as after(minecraft:hopper_minecart) matched nothing. 

 ItemMatcher.id("minecraft:empty_map").and(ItemMatcher.damage(2))
Since:
1.0.0
